title: Predicting type 2 diabetes via machine learning integration of multiple omics from human pancreatic islets
summary: DIABLO/PLS multi-omics integration predicted type 2 diabetes status and identified associated biomarkers in a small cross-sectional donor sample; independent clinical validation was not established.
organization: Epigenetics and Diabetes Unit, Department of Clinical Sciences, Lund University Diabetes Centre, Scania University Hospital, Lund University, 205 02, Malmö, Sweden

evidence.tested: DIABLO/PLS multi-omics integration predicted type 2 diabetes status and identified associated biomarkers in a small cross-sectional donor sample; independent clinical validation was not established.
evidence.unknown: The result came from a small cross-sectional donor sample; independent diagnostic performance and prospective clinical utility were not established.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
